gates.clock_underflow: Period-read planning uses an empty horizon when now<epoch but retains now/epoch; deployed helper early exits precede checked subtraction. Pool field5==0 returns raw even then; active clocks reject with panic0x11.
gates.cursor_input: Nonzero pool hourly rate requires all4 cursor words. At currentHour0, traces show cursor getter called before zero-time exit. For timestamp<epoch the loader still requires cursors conservatively, though execution panics in the clock getter before reading cursors.
gates.daily: pool field6==0 OR pool field5==0, OR currentDay==0, OR pool cursor1>=currentDay
gates.finite: Both helpers must take their entry exit; pool balance then equals raw root0. When either helper proceeds, it unconditionally calls token.balanceOf(the same pool) before any period allocation.
gates.hourly: pool field5==0, OR currentHour==0, OR pool cursor0>=currentHour
gates.recursive: Unchanged STATICCALL state repeats the same dependency. Bounded gas traces show repeated pool balance calls and out-of-gas propagation; host guard rejects rather than emulating a gas budget.
gates.zero_period: Even total/user/reward zero does not avoid the nested balance call because it precedes the period loop.
